name: Tofu Coconut Curry with Peaches, Spinach, Cilantro & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
2 peaches
½ small bunch cilantro
1 (2 ½ cm) piece ginger root
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and salt to the bowl with the cauliflower rice, then stir to combine. Transfer to another baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in the reserved bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp cornstarch
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve both skillet and bowl for later use.)
While the tofu is cooking, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the peaches. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peaches, cilantro, ginger, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ tsp curry powder
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return tofu to the skillet, along with coconut milk, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!
